factual_claims.source_evidence: Profit before tax was SEK 16,012 million (10,403) as shown in the Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income. Foreign exchange gains/losses of SEK 3,996 million are detailed in the Cash Flow Statement.

factual_claims.claim: Profit for the year increased to SEK 13,056 million compared with SEK 7,621 million in 2024, despite the company recording a goodwill impairment loss of SEK 3,707 million during the period.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Profit for the period was SEK 13,056 million (7,621) with a goodwill impairment loss of SEK 3,707 million as shown in the Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income and Goodwill and Intangible Assets note.

factual_claims.claim: Income tax expenses increased moderately to SEK 2,955 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Income tax expense increased to SEK 2,955 million (2,781) as detailed in Note 2.8 Income Tax Expenses.

factual_claims.claim: The company made continued progress in strengthening its balance sheet and credit metrics.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Discussion of improved Net LTV (52.2% vs 56.4%) and Interest Coverage Ratio (2.0x vs 1.9x) in the Funding and Alternative Performance Measures sections indicates balance sheet strengthening.

factual_claims.claim: Net loan-to-value improved significantly to 52.2% at the end of 2025 compared with 56.4% in 2024, supported by debt repayment funded through cash proceeds from the privatisation programme and asset monetisation.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Net LTV improved to 52.2% (56.4%) as shown in the Alternative Performance Measures table and discussed in the Funding section.

factual_claims.claim: The interest coverage ratio improved slightly to 2.0x from 1.9x, while interest expenses remained stable at SEK 6,536 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Interest Coverage Ratio (ICR) improved to 2.0x (1.9x) and interest expenses were SEK 6,536 million (6,554) as shown in the Alternative Performance Measures table and Interest Expenses section.

factual_claims.claim: The average interest rate at year-end ended at 3.43% compared with 3.01% in the prior year.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Average interest rate ended the year at 3.43% from 3.01% a year ago as stated in the Interest Expenses section.

factual_claims.claim: Total equity rose to SEK 150,557 million from SEK 147,803 million, driven by comprehensive income for the period.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Total equity increased to SEK 150,557 million (147,803) as shown in the Consolidated Statement of Financial Position and Equity section.

factual_claims.claim: Overall, 2025 was characterized by disciplined capital execution, enhanced operating profitability, strategic portfolio trimming, and balance sheet deleveraging.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The summary aligns with the detailed performance metrics presented throughout the report, including flat revenue, improved NOI margin, active privatisation programme, reduced Net LTV, and increased equity.
